verdict.rationale: Anrok is a SaaS tax-compliance platform, so letting customers choose a data storage region is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack never mentions data residency or storage region. References to 'jurisdictions' and 'countries' describe tax obligations, not where customer data is hosted, so they don't count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
